name: Field Guide
intro: Animals of this world, and the robots you build. The quest book teaches the machines, the ships, and the named bosses. The Ice Maze has its own tab. The last section is rumor. A few of those things have names. The rest do not.

getting_started.title: This tab
getting_started.text: One book, one key. Aquamirae is a different tab. Cataclysm, the Twilight Forest, the Aether, and Bosses' Rise stay in the quest book.

getting_started.title: Faded means you have not held it
getting_started.summary: The book only notices your inventory.
getting_started.text: A picture you have not carried yet sits faded. Seeing a creature is not enough. The note is kept on your own machine.

getting_started.title: Weight of a herd
getting_started.summary: From 0 to 8. Sick at the bottom.
getting_started.text: Adult animals start at weight 1 and can reach 8. At 0 they are sick: a green tint, and their drops and experience shrink. A wild animal is not weighed until you leash it or breed it. Light, open ground, and water nearby help it gain. A filled cauldron counts as water and is drunk down a level when it does. Crowding, a sealed hole, and a poor diet take weight off. The check rests at night.

getting_started.title: Shoes on a horse
getting_started.text: Iron, gold, diamond, and netherite horseshoes. Each step up is faster, steps higher, and jumps harder.

getting_started.title: Mind the deep
getting_started.text: A few of the things down there have a name people will say aloud. The others are only a scrap: a size, a sound, a place. Read them before you dive past the light. The pages will not fill in after you meet them.

pages.title: Pigeon
pages.summary: Common across the overworld. Feed it wheat seeds, beetroot seeds, melon seeds, pumpkin seeds, or torchflower seeds. The weight list still treats it as a grazer, so a lit pasture fattens it.

pages.title: Butterfly
pages.summary: It shows up across the overworld, not in one biome. The weight list marks it a grazer. It is not stock you pen, but once you leash or breed one, the weight rules apply.

pages.title: Ostrich
pages.excerpt: Savanna. Seeds, and a spider eye.
pages.summary: Savanna. Tall. The weight list calls it a grazer. What you actually feed it is seeds, and it will also take a spider eye. A low roof makes a poor pen.

pages.title: Giraffe
pages.summary: Savanna. It lowers its head to graze. Feed it leaves or an apple. Marked a grazer for weight, so it wants grass, light, and open ground, not a sealed stall.

pages.title: Kiwi
pages.excerpt: Jungle. Seeds, and a spider eye.
pages.summary: Jungle. Seeds are most of its food, and it will take a spider eye. The weight list still marks it a grazer.

pages.title: Hedgehog
pages.summary: Forest. Feed it a spider eye. Frighten it and it balls up. It picks items up off the ground, it has quills, and spiders keep away from it.

pages.title: Capybara
pages.summary: Jungle. Feed it sugar cane, carrot, wheat, apple, or melon. It is not on the grazer list, so the weight mod treats it as an omnivore.

pages.title: Red Panda
pages.summary: Jungle. Bamboo, sweet berries, glow berries, or a spider eye. Treated as an omnivore for weight.

pages.title: Crocodile
pages.excerpt: Swamps. It bites, and it lays eggs.
pages.summary: Swamps. It swims, it walks the bank, and it will attack. It lays eggs. Feed it meat. Treated as an omnivore for weight. It is not one of the things in the last section.

pages.title: Hippopotamus
pages.excerpt: Swamps. It lies down, and it will charge.
pages.summary: Swamps. It will attack, and it lies down to rest. Feed it sugar cane, kelp, or seagrass. Water nearby helps its weight. Treated as an omnivore.

pages.title: Penguin
pages.summary: The cold overworld. Feed it fish. Treated as an omnivore for weight.

pages.title: Seal
pages.summary: Beaches. Feed it fish. Treated as an omnivore for weight. Not a creature from the last section.

pages.title: Vulture
pages.summary: Deserts. Feed it rotten flesh. Treated as an omnivore for weight.

pages.title: Dragonfly
pages.summary: Swamps, in the same water as the crocodiles and the hippos. Treated as an omnivore for weight.

pages.title: Starfish
pages.summary: Beaches and the ocean. The weight list marks it a grazer. This is the Re:Animal starfish. Hybrid Aquatic has another.

pages.title: Sea Urchin
pages.summary: Beaches and the ocean. Feed it kelp or seagrass. Marked a grazer for weight. Hybrid Aquatic has a different urchin in the shoals.

pages.title: Jellyfish
pages.summary: Open ocean. Not on the grazer list, so the weight mod treats it as an omnivore. The jellies in the shoals section are Hybrid Aquatic, and there are fourteen of those.

pages.title: Figures shaped like players
pages.excerpt: Mobs, not people at the keyboard.
pages.summary: Some figures in the world are shaped like players. They are mobs.

pages.title: River fish
pages.summary: Seventeen kinds, in rivers, tropical rivers, jungle, marsh, mangrove, swamp, and some caves. Among them: carp, tetra, piranha, pleco, betta, cichlid, discus, gourami, and golden dorado. These are Hybrid Aquatic. They are not the last section.

pages.title: Ocean fish
pages.summary: Forty-five kinds. Reefs, seagrass, cold and warm oceans, and the trenches. Among them: clownfish, barracuda, coelacanth, anglerfish, barreleye, fangtooth, and blobfish. Hybrid Aquatic. Not the things the last section refuses to name.

pages.title: Sharks
pages.excerpt: From the beach to the trench.
pages.summary: Thirteen kinds, from shallow coasts through the deep oceans and the trenches. Among them: great white, hammerhead, bull, basking, goblin, thresher, frilled, and lantern shark. Large, and still not the last section.

pages.title: Jellies
pages.summary: Fourteen kinds. Beaches, reefs, mangroves, and the deep water. Among them: moon jelly, lion's mane, box jelly, barrel jelly, and comb jelly.

pages.title: Squid and octopus
pages.summary: Six kinds. Cuttlefish and octopus on the reefs and the shallows. Arrow squid and firefly squid in the open water. Giant squid and colossal squid down in the trenches.

pages.title: Crabs and kin
pages.summary: Sixteen kinds. Beaches, rivers, reefs, and the thermal vents. Among them: hermit, fiddler, ghost, horseshoe, coconut crab, lobster, crayfish, and the giant isopod in the cold dark.

pages.title: Shore mammals
pages.summary: Four. The otter keeps to rivers and tropical rivers. Manatee and dugong stay on seagrass and in the mangroves. The orca is the cold one: cold oceans, frozen oceans, and temperate oceans.

pages.title: Critters
pages.summary: Hybrid Aquatic's own five: starfish, sea urchin, sea slug, sea cucumber, and the scaly-foot snail of the vents. Beaches, reefs, seagrass, and the deep. The starfish and urchin in Herds and burrows are the Re:Animal ones, a different creature with the same common name.

pages.title: Where they stand
pages.summary: Their structures generate on Big Globe land, on the order of 800 blocks apart. Monasteries and umvuthana groves are part of that spread.

pages.title: Foliaath
pages.summary: The seed grows a baby. It gets hungry twice a day. Toss it meat. It is fully grown after two days.

pages.title: Grottol
pages.excerpt: What you carry out of the dark.
pages.summary: The Captured Grottol is the one this book can record. Luminous Jelly, eaten, gives a short night vision.

pages.title: Lantern
pages.summary: Luminous Jelly is the thing you bring back and eat.

pages.title: Naga
pages.summary: A Naga Fang brews poison resistance, fletches darts, or becomes a Naga Fang Dagger. The dagger poisons, and it hits harder from behind.

pages.title: Bluff
pages.summary: The Bluff Rod repairs geomancy gear. Give it to Tongbi and his test begins.

pages.title: Tongbi, the Sculptor
pages.summary: His challenge forbids placing blocks, breaking blocks, teleporting, and flying. The Geomancer Staff is his. The beads, robe, belt, and sandals are the rest of that clothing.

pages.title: Umvuthana
pages.summary: Bliss jumps. Faith adds health. Fear is swift. Fury is strong. Misery resists. Rage hastes. Crane and Raptor are the other shapes.

pages.title: Umvuthi, the Sunbird
pages.summary: The Sol Visage does not wear out. Equip it.

pages.title: Frostmaw
pages.summary: Hold the Ice Crystal and it calls a whirlwind. It recharges in your inventory.

pages.title: Ferrous Wroughtnaut
pages.summary: The Wrought Helm and the Axe of a Thousand Metals do not wear out. The axe swings in a wide arc and can slam the ground. The Earthrend Gauntlet lifts stone out of the ground.

pages.title: Elokosa
pages.summary: The Howler is the greater shape. Each paw lays a different effect on whoever is standing nearby.

pages.title: Chemical X
pages.summary: Obtain a potion of Chemical X. A Mutant Snow Golem is made with it. A Spider Pig is a pig fed a fermented spider eye, then hit with Chemical X.

pages.title: Mutant Zombie
pages.excerpt: The hammer is for this fight.
pages.summary: The Hulk Hammer is the weapon the advancements pair with the Mutant Zombie.

pages.title: Mutant Creeper
pages.summary: The Creeper Shard and the Creeper Minion Tracker are the things this book can record. A minion can be hatched from its egg.

pages.title: Mutant Skeleton
pages.summary: Arms, ribs, a cage, a pelvis, limbs, and a full set of armor. The advancements ask for the whole set.

pages.title: Mutant Enderman
pages.summary: The Endersoul Hand is the item tied to this hunt. Clones and fragments are the other shapes.

pages.title: Mutant Snow Golem
pages.summary: The advancements call this one Frosty. Chemical X is how it is made.

pages.title: Spider Pig
pages.excerpt: A pig, an eye, a potion.
pages.summary: Feed a pig a fermented spider eye and throw Chemical X at it.

pages.title: Pumpkins
pages.summary: Pumpkinhead, Sir Pumpkinhead, Lord Pumpkinhead, Mr. Pumpkin, Mrs Pumpkin, Senor Pumpkin, the Pumpkin Bruiser, the Pumpkin Dunce, and the Pumpkin Spirit.

pages.title: Bone and hound
pages.summary: Bonescaller and the Supreme Bonescaller. Bone Imp, Decrepit Skeleton, Siamese Skeletons, Baby Skeleton, Skeleton Demoman, Skeleton Thrasher. Dread Hound and the Dire Hound Leader.

pages.title: Knights and spirits
pages.summary: Door Knight and Fallen Chaos Knight. Restless Spirit, Seared Spirit, Infernal Spirit, Spirit of Chaos, Spirit Guide, and Firelight. Nightmare Stalker and Scarlet Persecutor walk with them.

pages.title: The rest of that night
pages.excerpt: Named, and left at the name.
pages.summary: Barrel Zombie, Decaying Zombie, Zombie Bruiser, Zombie Clown, Zombie Fisherman, Zombie Lumberjack. Bloody Gadfly, Corpse Fly, Corpse Maggot, Corpse Fish, Glutton Fish. Diamond Termite, Thornshell Crab, Swarmer, Phantom Creeper, Missionary, Spiders Mother, Baby Spider, Krampus and his henchman, Felsteed.

pages.title: Fuel and a wrench
pages.excerpt: Coal, charcoal, or a blaze cake.
pages.summary: Every robot drinks coal, charcoal, or a blaze cake. The Anole sits idle in your hand or in a seat and does not burn fuel then. Sneak with a wrench to take one apart. Right-click with andesite, brass, or copper for a skin, and take the skin off with a wrench. Empty a hauler or a tank before you dismantle it, and finish building before you fill it.

pages.title: Anole
pages.excerpt: Sits on your shoulder. Spiders leave.
pages.summary: Early craft: andesite alloy, copper, an iron sheet, and a transmitter. Right-click the item on the ground to set it down, or hold it and it perches on your shoulder. Spiders and insects keep their distance. Sneak and right-click with copper to repair it. A wet sponge weathers a copper skin. A dry sponge clears that.

pages.title: Matchbox
pages.summary: A small spider. Give it torches and it places them in the dark, up to four stacks. Sneak and right-click to choose off, caves only, or sun and caves. Leave it wandering and it lights what it walks through. Andesite alloy, while sneaking, repairs it.

pages.title: Seeker
pages.excerpt: Show it an ore. A miss eats the sample.
pages.summary: Hand it an ore, a metal, or a mineral. It searches nearby and digs that block out of the ground. If it finds nothing, the sample is gone. A diamond or netherite pickaxe makes the dig faster. Right-click with an ore starts the search, so sneak when you only meant to change its skin.

pages.title: Oxhauler
pages.excerpt: Six chests, a crafting grid, and a plough.
pages.summary: Place the Middle on the ground. Then the Rear, the Front, and the Head, in that order. It holds six chests and a 3x3 grid. A mechanical plough tills. A mechanical harvester cuts crops. Brass, while sneaking, repairs it.

pages.title: Replete
pages.summary: Craft the Body on a mechanical crafter and place it. Each Leg is the next piece, six in all. The tank holds 160 buckets of any fluid. Right-click with a bucket to fill it or to pour into a tank. If the fluid on the ground matches what is inside, it drinks that up.

pages.title: The Kraken
pages.excerpt: Warm water, after the light is gone.
pages.summary: Sailors will say this name. It is the size of a ship stood on end: about twenty-four blocks across and more than forty tall, and it sounds like a squid. It belongs to lukewarm oceans, but in this world it does not rise into the upper sea. It waits where the light has already failed. People who come back talk about a scale. The book will not draw it.

pages.title: The Bloop
pages.excerpt: The one that takes a saddle.
pages.summary: This name is safe to say. It is large for a mount and small for the deep, about fourteen blocks long and ten tall, and its voice is an elder guardian's. It will take a saddle, its own or a horse's, and you can ride it. There is another of its kind. That one is not this page.

pages.title: Not the One You Saddle
pages.summary: About fourteen blocks to a side. The same elder-guardian voice as the one you can ride, and it calls the others when it is angry. Do not offer it a saddle. The book has no better name for it.

pages.title: Wider Than the Ship
pages.summary: No name worth printing. What gets reported is the width: nearly forty blocks across, and two dozen tall, big enough to shove a hull aside by being there. The sound people bring back is a warden's, from open water. Nobody has agreed where it keeps itself.

pages.title: When the Water Stands Up
pages.excerpt: Any ocean. Only in the dark.
pages.summary: No name. It is about eighteen blocks each way, and it is met in every kind of ocean, but not in the upper sea. When it dies, the water stands up in a column and the impact goes off like a blast. Do not be underneath it for the end.

pages.title: It Unbuilds
pages.excerpt: It looks for what you made.
pages.summary: No name. Deep oceans only, and still only where the light has failed. About fourteen blocks wide and twenty-five tall. It sounds like a warden, and then a boom finds whoever is near, the way a sonic shriek does. It goes looking for things players have built, and then it takes them apart.

pages.title: Inside the Monument
pages.summary: No name. Ocean monuments. About eight blocks tall, which is small only next to the others. Stand near it and your arms go heavy, the way an elder guardian makes them. It hits, and it hits from farther than a diver expects.

items.name: Foliaath Seed
items.desc: Plant in grass. Feed the baby meat. Grown after two days.

items.name: Luminous Jelly
items.desc: Eat for a short night vision.

items.name: Naga Fang
items.desc: Poison resistance, darts, or a dagger.

items.name: Ice Crystal
items.desc: Hold it to call a whirlwind.

items.name: Axe of a Thousand Metals
items.desc: Does not wear out. Wide swing, and a ground slam.

items.name: Hulk Hammer
items.desc: The weapon paired with the Mutant Zombie.
